brand_identity.name: Touré Family Recipes
brand_identity.emotional_goal: To make every digital interaction feel like passing a handwritten recipe card across the kitchen table.

usage_rules: NEVER use pure black (#000000). Use the Warm Charcoal (foreground) instead.
Background is NOT white. It is 'Linen' (hsl(36, 33%, 97%)).
Primary color (Terracotta) is for high-priority actions (Save, Cook, Upload).
Secondary color (Sage Green) is for tags, nature elements, and success states.
Accent color (Mustard) is for 'Chef's Tips' or highlighting special ingredients.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use a subtle grain overlay on the main background if possible to enhance the 'paper' feel.

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 px-8 py-6 text-lg font-serif transition-transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 shadow-lg shadow-primary/20
buttons.secondary: rounded-full bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/90 px-6 py-4 font-sans
buttons.outline: rounded-full border-2 border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary/5 px-6 py-4 font-sans font-bold tracking-wide
buttons.ghost: rounded-lg hover:bg-muted text-foreground px-4 py-2 font-medium

cards.recipe_card: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-card border border-border/50 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300
cards.recipe_image: h-full w-full object-cover transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-110

inputs.base: rounded-xl border-2 border-border/50 bg-white/50 px-4 py-3 text-lg focus:border-primary focus:ring-4 focus:ring-primary/10 transition-all placeholder:text-muted-foreground/70
inputs.label: text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-2 block

grid_system.feed: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8 md:gap-12
grid_system.detail: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 lg:gap-24 items-start

detail_page.hero_section: col-span-full lg:col-span-7 relative h-[60vh] lg:h-[85vh] rounded-3xl overflow-hidden
detail_page.content_section: col-span-full lg:col-span-5 flex flex-col gap-10 py-8

hero_cooking.alt: Mother and son cooking cookies together
hero_cooking.usage: Landing page hero, Auth page background

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Playfair Display'.
DO NOT use pure white backgrounds. Use the 'Linen' off-white.
Images must have 'object-cover' and rounded corners.
Buttons should feel tactile (slight shadow, scale on press).
Forms should be clean and spacious, not cramped.
Mobile-first: Ensure touch targets are at least 44px.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building the Touré Family Recipe App. Follow the 'Spice & Linen' design system strictly. Use the provided image URLs for placeholders. Implement the 'Bento' grid for the recipe feed. Ensure the 'Add Recipe' flow is intuitive and uses the camera icon prominently. Use Shadcn components but override their styles to match the rounded, warm aesthetic defined here.
